edit.ability:
(1CD)(2U) Place a scan counter on a creature besides this one. 
(OYT) If a creature has scan counters equal to its star level, this creature may destroy those counters to summon a copy of that creature as a protective minion (must stay in PF) with -50% HP and -1 bar to other base stats (reductions apply to summoned minions and other forms).
This creature may only have one minion at a time with this ability, and (OYT) May destroy the current minion to summon another one.
